name: Playwright CLI (playwright-cli)
description: Installs Playwright's CLI for coding agents (playwright-cli, from npm playwright) with a browser it can launch, or reuses a Playwright Chromium that's already installed. Pinned: each Playwright release launches only its own browser build. Needs Node.js 22 or newer.

version.description: Version of the playwright npm package. Match Microsoft.Playwright in your .NET tests so they find the same browser.

github.copilot.chat.codeGeneration.instr.text: This dev container includes the Playwright CLI (`playwright-cli`), with a browser, on the `PATH`. Run `playwright-cli --help` for the command reference.
